entities.summary: Tadeusz Bradecki (b. 1955-01-02, Zabrze) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zabrze and Poland. Known in the fields of poland, poets & playwrights, europe.
